clips.title: The story
paras: A friendly barkeep points travelers eager for a livelier gathering toward the port of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale. Those looking for wilder company are directed to seek out Nixxrax Fillamug at the Salty Sailor Tavern.

Word passes quickly between drink-servers and their patrons, and news travels far beyond the local counter. A friendly bartender passes along a tip about where the genuine commotion is brewing, pointing anyone searching for wilder spectacles toward the port of Booty Bay.
The destination is the Salty Sailor Tavern, a lively establishment maintained by goblins amidst the bustle of Stranglethorn Vale. There, Nixxrax Fillamug keeps cups topped up for anyone who walks in.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.
The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.
Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.
Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
